notes.text: Literally, ten yokes, or the amount of land that ten yokes of oxen can plow in one day, which is about 10 acres or 4 hectares.

notes.after: acres of vineyard shall yield one bath,
notes.text: 1 bath is about 22 litres, 5.8 U. S. gallons, or 4.8 imperial gallons

notes.after: neyard shall yield one bath, And a homer
notes.text: 1 homer is about 220 litres or 6 bushels

notes.after: nd a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.
notes.text: 1 ephah is about 22 litres or 0.6 bushels or about 2 pecks)-- only one tenth of what was sown.
Sheol is the place of the dead.

notes.after: a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
a man's pen, 'For Maher Shalal Hash Baz;
notes.text: "Maher Shalal Hash Baz" means "quick to the plunder, swift to the spoil."
